channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: High Consumption of Preservative-Rich Processed Foods May Raise Cancer Risk: Study
item.description: A major BMJ study links common food preservatives to increased risks of cancer and Type 2 diabetes.

item.title: Started at 50, Stronger at 61: One Woman’s Fitness Transformation Is Inspiring Millions, Redefining Age and Strength
item.description: Starting fitness at 50, a 61-year-old woman’s viral transformation is reshaping conversations around ageing, strength, and mindset.

item.title: 3 Indians Among 28 Crew on Russian-Flagged Tanker Seized by US Over Venezuela Links: Reports
item.description: A multinational crew, including three Indians, was detained after US forces seized a tanker over alleged Venezuelan oil sanctions violations.

item.title: Bangladesh Suspends Key Visa Services In India Citing Security Risks Ahead Of General Elections
item.description: Bangladesh halts most visa services in India due to security concerns, while keeping business travel open.

item.title: Removing Stray Dogs Could Cost India Rs 26,800 Crore, Supreme Court Informed
item.description: The Supreme Court was informed that mass removal of stray dogs could cost Rs 26,800 crore, prompting calls to adopt humane, cost-effective sterilisation models like Lucknow’s instead.

item.title: Karnataka Opposes Kerala’s Malayalam Language Bill, Flags Threat to Kannada Minorities in Kasaragod
item.description: Karnataka opposes Kerala’s new language bill, claiming it unfairly targets Kannada-speaking minorities in border districts.

item.title: Peak-Hour Fire in Garbage-Carrying Muck Train at Kurla Disrupts Mumbai Central Railway Services
item.description: A fire in a garbage-carrying train at Kurla briefly halted Central Railway services during evening rush hour, causing delays but no injuries.

item.title: Wearing Face Mask, Hijab or Niqab? Bihar Restricts Entry to Jewellery Shops With Covered Faces
item.description: Bihar jewellers bar entry for customers with covered faces, including hijabs and helmets, citing security concerns.

item.title: Iran Protests: Buildings Burn in Tehran as Anti-Government Demonstrations Intensify Amid Internet Shutdown
item.description: Economic despair, currency collapse and rising prices have pushed Iran’s traders, students and citizens into widespread protests met by shutdowns and crackdowns.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh Shocker: Cop Flees After Gang-Raping 14-Year-Old with YouTuber; SHO Suspended for Cover-Up
item.description: A 14-year-old girl was abducted and brutally assaulted in Kanpur’s Sachendi, exposing police lapses as a sub-inspector flees while his accomplice is arrested.
